lines: Never bodies and the rest — long clay-lump or … —
l4.sanskrit_cite: na syājjātu śarīrādi dīrghamṛtpiṇḍa eva vā ata evārthanīyatvātsaṃniveśo viśiṣyate

reads_against.argmap: What of bodies and arrangement? → No bodies otherwise; end-led arrangement excels.
c1_essence: Potter necessary, nature watching, helpers insufficient, wisdom and will required, sufficiency tested (vv28-33).
Array excels by ends; Lord and un-Lord fenced off atomically; pradhāna will-less yet person-aim-ness stands (vv34-36).
